verdict.rationale: A natural-language operating interface, such as an in-dashboard assistant or an agent integration, is a fair capability for a managed search service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only programmatic SDKs, a dashboard for browsing and queries, an OpenAPI spec, and an llms.txt file. Native embedding of text for semantic search is a search feature, not natural-language control of the product, so nothing documents operating turbopuffer through natural-language commands.
